command:
set -euo pipefail
kubectl wait backup/pre-upgrade-20260908 -n kcm-system --for=jsonpath='{.status.phase}'=Completed --timeout=30s
kubectl get backup/pre-upgrade-20260908 -n kcm-system -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d["status"])'
export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig
HOST=$(kubectl get gateway training-gateway -o jsonpath='{.status.addresses[0].value}')
curl -fsS --max-time 20 -H 'Host: gateway-test.example.com' "http://$HOST" | head -8
kubectl -n kyverno get deployment kyverno-admission-controller
